title: Realizing Chromatic Types at Nested Fixed Points
exact_target: Let $H<G$ be subgroups of a finite $p$-group. For which pairs $(m,n)$ does there exist a finite $G$-spectrum $X$ such that $\Phi^H X$ has chromatic type $m$ and $\Phi^G X$ has chromatic type $n$?
